title: feat(app-showcase): re-instate grid KPIs, role-gated note, History tab
body:
Companion to objectui [#1814](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/1814). Now that the SDUI renderer fixes landed, restore the showcase features that were dropped as workarounds during the earlier polish.

## What

**My Work** — KPI hero row moves from `flex` back to an equal-width **`grid`** (the layout grid is no longer shadowed by ObjectGrid). Sidebar gains a **per-user `visible`-gated note**: `user.email == 'admin@objectos.ai'` shows for the admin, while a note gated to a different email stays hidden — demonstrating component-level role gating.

**Account 360** — the **History tab** returns: `record:history` now self-fetches from `sys_activity` field_change events (`trackHistory` on status/industry), so it lists real audit entries instead of "No history yet".

## Verification

Browser-verified on `:5181`: `grid-cols-3` KPI row; the admin-only note shows while the other-user note is hidden; the History tab lists *"UPDATED · Industry: Finance → Technology"* after an industry change. `typecheck` + 20 showcase tests pass.
